answer: An agent marketplace requires each seller to lock a refundable bond for 30 days before accepting work, whether supplying umber pigment, drafting a sonnet, or designing a bridge. Each identity needs its own bond, so creating 1,000 sellers ties up 1,000 times the capital. A seller that signs conflicting receipts for the same escrow payment loses its bond when either buyer submits both signatures, making disposable identities costly to abuse.
